primary.role: primary causal comparisons C1-C6 and formal latency quality

external_exact_subset.role: separate frozen V8 evidence; never pooled with V17 cases

C1_PROPOSED_FULL.source: V17 selected candidate and recorded direct sequence
C1_PROPOSED_FULL.selection_rule: graph-and-margin-derived initial candidate; security admission; encrypted decision agreement and reserve policy; bounded monotone adjustment; first acceptable candidate; otherwise abstain
C1_PROPOSED_FULL.repair_count_interpretation: at most four candidate evaluations with bounded adjustments between evaluations

C2_DECISION_GATE_OFF.source: same recorded V17 direct sequence; no new execution
C2_DECISION_GATE_OFF.selection_rule: select the first candidate in recorded direct order that passes materialization, Security-V2 admission, encrypted execution, and finite-output validation; ignore decision agreement and rho-times-margin reserve tests
C2_DECISION_GATE_OFF.numerical_rule: retain only a preexisting pre-gate numerical rule if present; do not invent a threshold
C2_DECISION_GATE_OFF.label: decision-stability gate removed ablation

C3_INITIAL_ONLY.source: first recorded V17 direct candidate only
C3_INITIAL_ONLY.selection_rule: apply the full C1 decision-stability gate to the initial candidate and stop; no adjustment candidate may be considered

C4_PREEXISTING_DEFAULT_OR_LATENCY_ONLY.source: V17 artifacts created before result inspection
C4_PREEXISTING_DEFAULT_OR_LATENCY_ONLY.selection_rule: include FIXED_DEFAULT and LATENCY_ONLY_AGGRESSIVE as distinct diagnostic arms only where candidate identity, hash, predeclared rule, exact graph/input, and security result are present
C4_PREEXISTING_DEFAULT_OR_LATENCY_ONLY.missing_rule: record NO_PREEXISTING_BASELINE_AVAILABLE; never construct a replacement

C5_TRADITIONAL_OBJECTIVE_DIAGNOSTICS.source: security-admitted and execution-valid V17 finite-reference candidates
selection_rules: minimum RMS error only if the same RMS definition is present for every eligible candidate in every included case
C5_TRADITIONAL_OBJECTIVE_DIAGNOSTICS.purpose: diagnostic only; not named as an external system

C6_FINITE_REFERENCE.source: predeclared V17 depth-complete finite candidate set
C6_FINITE_REFERENCE.selection_rule: fastest decision-stability-acceptable candidate within the finite set
C6_FINITE_REFERENCE.role: offline existence, false-NO_SAFE, selected-rank, and selection-quality reference

C7_EXTERNAL_NATIVE_BASELINES.latency_rule: only portable-exact same-runtime arms may enter direct latency comparison; unsafe arms remain blocked diagnostics

outcome_definitions.decision_stability_acceptable: security and execution pass; selection-input decision flips equal zero; selection-input reserve-policy violations equal zero
outcome_definitions.separate_input_failure: separate-input decision flip or reserve-policy violation, or explicit REJECTED/FAILED result
outcome_definitions.false_no_safe: C1 abstains while C6 contains at least one acceptable candidate
outcome_definitions.latency_regret: (C1 formal total latency - C6 fastest-acceptable formal total latency) / C6 fastest-acceptable formal total latency
outcome_definitions.candidate_evaluation_reduction: 1 - sum(C1 candidate evaluations) / sum(C6 finite candidate evaluations)
outcome_definitions.selection_wall_clock_ratio: sum(finite-reference selection wall-clock) / sum(direct selection wall-clock) over rows with both boundaries measured
outcome_definitions.formal_latency_use: only existing exact candidate bindings measured under the V17 formal protocol
outcome_definitions.selection_stage_latency_use: diagnostic candidate ordering only; never relabeled as formal paired inference latency

primary_questions: C1 versus C6 finite-reference selection quality

bootstrap.unit: workload/model cluster when a repeated-split structure exists

required_conditions: cell required for a core V18 claim

prohibited: candidate rows or passes as independent samples
